meta.name: cavecrew
meta.description: Decision guide for delegating to caveman-style subagents. Tells the main thread WHEN to spawn `cavecrew-investigator` (locate code), `cavecrew-builder` (1-2 file edit), or `cavecrew-reviewer` (diff review) instead of doing the work inline or using vanilla `Explore`. Subagent output is caveman-compressed so the tool-result injected back into main context is ~60% smaller — main context lasts longer across long sessions. Trigger: "delegate to subagent", "use cavecrew", "spawn investigator/builder/reviewer", "save context", "compressed agent output".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分派编码任务给专门子代理,让长会话更持久
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你在长AI对话中写代码,希望把子任务交出去以省上下文。
copy.tagline_en: Delegate coding tasks to specialized subagents to make long sessions last
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you code in long AI conversations and need to delegate subtasks to free up context.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会根据任务类型决定是否派发三个压缩风格子代理之一：定位代码用 cavecrew-investigator，不超过 2 个文件的小改动用 cavecrew-builder，审查 diff 用 cavecrew-reviewer。子代理返回的压缩结果注入主上下文后体积约小 60%。
howto.when: 当你说“delegate to subagent”、“use cavecrew”、“spawn investigator/builder/reviewer”等触发词，或要求压缩代理输出、节省上下文时触发。

say.text: 用 cavecrew 找一下 X 函数在哪里定义的
say.note: 触发 investigator，返回带行号的压缩清单。

say.text: 派 cavecrew-builder 改这两个文件
say.note: 限 1-2 文件小改动，返回验证或 too-big 标记。

say.text: 让 cavecrew-reviewer 审一下这个 diff
say.note: 返回按行号排序的问题列表和汇总。

howto.what_en: After enabling, Claude decides whether to delegate a task to one of three caveman-style subagents: cavecrew-investigator for locating code, cavecrew-builder for 1-2 file edits, or cavecrew-reviewer for diff review. Their compressed output is ~60% smaller when injected into main context.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "delegate to subagent", "use cavecrew", "spawn investigator/builder/reviewer", etc., or ask for compressed agent output to save context.

say_en.text: Use cavecrew to find where X is defined.
say_en.note: Triggers investigator, returns line-numbered compressed list.

say_en.text: Spawn cavecrew-builder to edit these two files.
say_en.note: Limited to 1-2 file edits, returns verification or too-big.
Returns findings sorted by file and line.
